_about: Published facts the sizing model extrapolates from. Collected 2026-11-08. Sizes in bytes. 'z10_tiles' = Web Mercator z10 tiles whose centre falls inside the Geofabrik extract polygon (includes the polygon's coastal buffer); land-only counts are smaller.

us.name: United States
us.dem: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second (CONUS, HI, PR, part of AK); 1 arc-second for the rest of Alaska
us.terrain_land_note: estimate: CONUS 8.08M km2 at mean 38N (951 km2 per z10 tile) + Alaska 1.72M km2 at 63N (316 km2) + Hawaii; +/-15%

canada.name: Canada
canada.dem: NRCan MRDEM-30 everywhere, HRDEM (LiDAR, read at 2 m via overviews) where it exists
canada.terrain_land_note: rough estimate by latitude band (49-55N 3.0M km2, 55-60N 2.0M, 60-70N 2.5M, 70-83N 1.5M); Mercator makes the Arctic dominate; +/-30%

saudi.name: Saudi Arabia
saudi.pbf_source: https://download.openstreetmap.fr/extracts/asia/saudi_arabia-latest.osm.pbf (HEAD, 2026-11-08). Geofabrik has no Saudi-only extract; mapthing would install asia/gcc-states (257381178 bytes) or a custom polygon clipped from it.
saudi.z10_tiles_note: area-based: 2.15M km2 / (35.75 km z10 tile side at 24N)^2

3dep13.what: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second, 1x1 degree COG tiles, s3://prd-tnm StagedProducts/Elevation/13/TIFF/current/

3dep_1m.what: USGS 3DEP 1 m project DEMs (10x10 km UTM tiles), patchy coverage
3dep_1m.note: statewide areas run to terabytes; not used by default (see docs/elevation-sources.md)

mrdem30.what: NRCan MRDEM-30 national DTM, one COG

hrdem2m.what: NRCan HRDEM 2 m DTM mosaics (STAC collection hrdem-mosaic-2m)
hrdem2m.measured_by: STAC items + HEAD of each dtm asset, 2026-11-08 (6 items had no dtm asset)

glo30.what: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM, 1x1 degree COG tiles on s3://copernicus-dem-30m
glo30.saudi_tiles_note: about 190 full 1-degree cells of land at ~24N plus border cells

planetiler_planet.rules_of_thumb: disk: 1 GB + 5-10x PBF; RAM: >= 0.5x PBF free; JVM heap ~0.5x PBF

protomaps_planet.time: about 2 hours on a high-end desktop or server
